response:
Here’s one recipe you could try, using a food processor and electric hand grip to pull back on the raw lobster tail and squeeze juice out:

1) Cut off the head and the claw.

2) Pull back the body meat from the tail using one hand. Cut down one way for length.

3) Using a knife, break away one end of tail meat.

4) Use two fingers from above to grip the end of tail meat and pull back until juice is released. Rotate your hand to remove meat and tail from end.

5) Repeat above steps with another end.

6) For each tail, set aside four or five tail meat sections.

7) With food processor running, combine ingredients. Pulse once.

8) Add one cup chicken broth, ½ cup cold water and pulse again.

9) Add juice from juice can and pulse one final time. The lobster juice may need to be reserved to add flavor.

10) With hand holding food processer or electric hand grip, squeeze back and forth on lobster to remove liquid.

11) Repeat steps from above with juice canning.

12) When canning liquid is extracted from can and liquid in can has turned milky, add liquid in bowl to dissolve can liquid.

13) To add flavor into juice, add parsley, celery or lemon zest.

14) To finish dish, mix all juices on top of lobster. I suggest adding some butter and parsley leaves on top.

But the range doesn’t stop the accuracy there either! response:
There are a few methods of extinguishing a fire:

1.  Water: Pouring water onto the fire will cool it, and will often quickly put it out.

2.  Dry leaves: Collect dry leaves and sprinkle them on the fire.  The fire will continue to burn until it produces smoke, then dries out and goes out.

3.  Charcoal: Adding dry sticks or twigs to the fire will create a lighter fluid, and when ignited produces smoke which often quickly extinguishes the fire.

This rise in the air allows the Pacific Ocean to spill more water into the Gulf of Alaska. If the temperature of the waters in the eastern tropical Pacific warms, then the trade winds decrease. There are several ways how cryptocurrencies work, but one of the most common ways is called a “blockchain technology”. It is a shared, unalterable database that records all transactions. So every time you buy or sell something, you add a new entry to the blockchain. The blockchain is like a ledger, but kept by everyone. It cannot be altered, because anyone can add a new block to the chain, but if it is already on the network, it will not show up. 

A cryptocurrency is a digital coin or token on the blockchain, that represents a cryptocurrency. Bitcoin was the first cryptocurrency that gained a lot of attention, and it is still one of the most well-known. There are many others, but Bitcoin is still the largest and most well-known. It is also one of the most expensive. The value of most cryptocurrencies is very volatile, meaning they can fluctuate greatly in value. It is very important to know that a cryptocurrency does not necessarily represent anything, it is just a digital token on the blockchain.
